messages:
olivia_cs: Heads-up — Chiron onboarding went live last Wed. Prod traffic ~30 rps but we're seeing tail latency spikes on /v1/summarize (p95 ~480ms, p99 ~1.6s). Renewal flagged as at-risk if latency doesn't improve before next touch (~2w). Thinking proactive options: int8 quantization + route low-cost traffic to redwood-compact-v2 for non-sensitive requests, keep redwood-full for high-quality/fallback. Also enable prefix KV caching for repeated prompts. Can we sketch quick impact estimates? TL;DR: ~30-40% token cost reduction, expected p99 down to ~600-800ms in staging. /cc @connor_se @priya_ml

connor_se: Have you seen any quality regressions on their eval set? If small we can canary. I can run local perf tests on their prompt set today.

priya_ml: Quick check this morning: their tiny eval (12 prompts) shows ROUGE drop ~0.8 points when moving compact-v2 -> int8. Short summaries ok, long-doc coherence slightly worse. Suggest split routing: docs > 2k tokens -> full model, else compact. Also add confidence heuristic: if model_confidence < 0.6 then route to full.

ben_eng: I can draft a canary routing + autoscale plan. Suggest start 5% traffic to compact for 48h then 25% if stable. Add alert on quality regressions + auto-rollback. Example routing snippet: ```routes:
- name: compact-canary
  match: request.metadata.routing_hint == \"non-sensitive\" or request.tokens < 2048
  model: redwood-compact-v2-int8
  weight: 5
```

olivia_cs: FYI renewal owner also flagged low adoption of batch-embeddings — I'll schedule an enablement call next week. Prefer to demonstrate cost savings first to build confidence before pushing new features.

connor_se: Ran a quick perf run locally: int8 compact reduced p99 from 1.6s -> 700ms on A10080 with batch size 8. Throughput up ~2.1x. Pushed staging traces + logs to the dashboard: https://console.redwood/internal/dash/chiron/12345 (staging project id 12345).

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Canary rollout request accepted. Scheduled start 2025-03-05T14:30Z. Monitoring hooks: p50/p95/p99, token_cost, model_confidence, quality_checks. Auto-rollback if quality drop > 1.5 ROUGE or p99 increases > 20%.

olivia_cs: Plan of action: (1) Priya run extended eval (200 prompts) by EOD Tue. (2) Ben prepare canary + alert runbook. (3) Connor validate staging perf and run synthetic tail tests. I'll draft a short "cost-first pilot" email to Chiron to set expectations. LMK blockers.

ben_eng: On it — assigning infra ticket and adding a short runbook + slack alert formatting. I can have the initial canary config in staging by EOD tomorrow.

priya_ml: I'll also try a light prompt rewrite (remove repetitive context) — could shave ~10% tokens and reduce tail latency. Will include regression matrix for precision/recall metrics.

olivia_cs: :thumbsup: Thanks team. If all green, target full rollout in ~10 days. I'll add notes to the renewal playbook and ping the renewal lead.

connor_se: sgtm. One blocker: we need a quick smoke test on their long-doc pipeline (≥6k tokens). If someone can provide a recent long-doc sample I can run it through staging.

olivia_cs: I'll DM a sanitized long-doc to the channel and also attach a CSV of their top 50 prompts.

ben_eng: added a temporary dashboard panel for long-doc tail and a synthetic generator job. Will share link when ready.

olivia_cs: Closing loop — thanks everyone. I'll update Chiron with the pilot timeline and note the rollback safeguards.
